M2: Energy Access and Inclusive Energy Services
This chapter serves as a basic guide for building energy systems that revolve around well-being, sustainability, and justice.
In our exploration, we will discuss innovative solutions for energy access, policy mechanisms to expand energy access, the pivotal roles of partnerships and stakeholders, community-based approaches.
We also take a deeper dive into the crucial aspects of affordability, inclusivity, and an intersectional approach.
This lesson explores how an intersectional approach can transform energy access by addressing the overlapping identities that shape people's experience and challenges.
The lesson presents practical strategies to operationalize intersectionality in sustainable energy acces sprogramming.
The lesson highlights the key technological solutions that can accelerate the path towards universal energy access while supporting the transition to clean energy.
This lesson explains how financing mechanisms can incentivize energy access and inclusive energy services with a focus on underserved and vulnerable communities.
This lesson explores three policy instruments: subsidies, tax incentives and regulatory reforms, and how they contribute to the promotion of sustainable energy solutions.

This lesson explores the importance of multi-stakeholder partnerships and the role of international organizations, NGOs, development agencies, the private sector and local communities in advancing energy access objectives, as well as the associated challenges and conflicts.
